name: downsample
expr: y0 = downsample(1:10, 3); y1 = downsample(1:10, 3, 1); y2 = downsample(1:10, 3, 2);
comment: Sig y=downsample(x,n[,phase]). Keeps x[phase], x[phase+n], … (phase 0..n-1). downsample(1:10,3) -> [1 4 7 10]; phase 1 -> [2 5 8]; phase 2 -> [3 6 9]. numkit previously IGNORED phase -- now honored. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
